facts.fact: Statistics Mauritius published Economic and Social Indicators Issue No 1949, Population and Vital Statistics Jan-Jun 2026, on 28 August 2026, with vital statistics drawn from the Civil Status Division's computerised system.
facts.system: Economic and Social Indicators Issue No 1949

facts.fact: The issue reports 6,386 live births and 6,333 deaths registered in January-June 2026, extracted from the Civil Status Division's computerised system, per Statistics Mauritius.
facts.system: Economic and Social Indicators Issue No 1949

systems.system: computerised system at the Civil Status Division
